Stock list and description/icon presentation, scrolling and refresh retain supplied stock reference. Quantity input wraps +/-1 and changes10 with clamps; initial1 and cancel0. Confirm display uses full quantity*buyprice. Timed feedback waits1.5 seconds except USE; no rendered-pixel claim.

Normal Buy loop: first affordability guard, important quantity1 confirmation or ordinary maximum min(999,floor(money/price)) with free999, explicit qty0/refusal cancel, second affordability check. Add one by one; complete success updates spent money stat and item count then wallet, deletes important owned from aliased stock, messages, bonus. Failure removes just-added prefix one by one, removal failure raises; no purchase stat/wallet update on that branch.

Premier bonus after purchase commit: quantity>=10 and registered Premier data. Generous mode any PokeBall floor(qty/10), add until failure, actual bonus count increments stat; zero additions still displays zero result. Legacy only POKEBALL one successful extra. No rollback of purchase on bonus capacity failure.
